name: International Labour Organization
description: A UN-blue field charged at the centre with the white ILO emblem: the letters 'ILO' within a cogwheel, framed by two olive branches.
history: The ILO, founded in 1919 under the Treaty of Versailles and a UN specialised agency since 1946, sets international labour standards; its flag places the cogwheel emblem on the UN blue.
